guards: Guards the ORDER of two gates that look interchangeable and are not. A draft truncated at the token ceiling is rejected against the final-answer contract BEFORE attribution runs, because a line cut off mid-value can be perfectly cited and still wrong - 'her potassium this morning was 5' passes every grounding check there is. Also pins that one repair attempt is offered and that the discarded draft reaches nothing.

answer.intent: REQUIREMENTS.md §13.1's 'unexpected / unparseable model output' row, taking its good branch: a draft truncated at the token ceiling is rejected against the final-answer contract BEFORE the verifier, one bounded repair is issued, and the repaired answer ships. The truncated text - which cut off mid-value - must not appear anywhere in what reached the clinician.
